courses.summary: 瓦爾霍爾是挪威政府持續記錄的海上油田；以成熟設施的沉降接口、荷載與量測趨勢建立本課。本課依序分析舊新設施相對位移、重量與承載面積、連接件循環負荷、不同年代壁厚資料、高程基準可追溯性，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Valhall is documented by the Norwegian government; this case studies mature-facility settlement interfaces, loads and measurement trends. The course analyses relative movement of old and new facilities, weight and bearing area, cyclic loading of connections, thickness records from different eras, traceability of elevation datums, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
